title: AuthHide
description: A mod that can hide your password from the screen when you're logging in
body:
# AuthHide
AuthHide is a lightweight Fabric client-side mod that protects your passwords from being exposed in the chat history.
Features

- 🔒 Password masking — Passwords are hidden with * characters while typing
- 🗑️ History protection — Auth commands are never saved to chat history
- 🔄 Toggle anytime — Use /authhide to enable or disable the mod instantly
- 🌍 Multi-language support — Supports EN, HU, DE, FR, ES, RU

Supported commands
The following commands are protected:
/login, /register, /unregister, /changepassword, /changepass, /email, /captcha, /2fa, /totp, /recovery, /setemail, /setpassword and their shortcuts.
Usage
Simply install the mod and it will work automatically. Use /authhide to toggle the protection on or off.

Why?
When playing on servers with authentication plugins, your password can accidentally appear in chat history if you press the up arrow key. AuthHide prevents this from happening!
